description: This file defines a controller class `ViewMyDetailsController` within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling user requests to view their personal details by redirecting to the appropriate URL based on the authenticated user's employee number.

classes.name: ViewMyDetailsController
classes.description: A controller class that handles the display of the logged-in user's personal details by redirecting them to the specific URL with their employee number.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request to view personal details by fetching the employee number of the authenticated user and redirecting to the personal details page.
